question.prompt: In quadrilateral \(ABCD\), \(AB\parallel CD\), \(AB=CD=7\), and \(BC=4\). Find the perimeter of quadrilateral \(ABCD\).

solutions.explanation: One pair of opposite sides is parallel and equal in length, so \(ABCD\) is a parallelogram. Thus \(AD=BC=4\), and the perimeter is \(2\times(7+4)=22\).
solutions.title: Parallelogram recognition and perimeter
